rows.rawText: Which statement is true for all species of organisms? A A species is a group of organisms that are genetically identical. D A species is a group of organisms that reproduce by sexual means only.
rows.stem: Which statement is true for all species of organisms?

options.A: A species is a group of organisms that are genetically identical.
options.B: A species is a group of organisms that produce fertile offspring.
options.C: A species is a group of organisms that reproduce both asexually and sexually.
options.D: A species is a group of organisms that reproduce by sexual means only.
